name: Consecrate Battlefield
body:
School evocation [good]; Level cleric/oracle 6, inquisitor 6

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S, M (a vial of holy water and 1 pound of platinum dust worth 500 gp)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 feet + 10 feet per level)
Area 100-ft.-radius emanation
Duration 1 day/level

DESCRIPTION

You fill the battlefield with positive energy. This spell functions as consecrate, except as above and as follows:

Any creature slain within the area cannot be turned into undead for the duration of the spell, even if removed.

This spell counters and dispels desecrate and desecrate battlefield.
